cagey_price_guard.today: offered <= 1.15 x independent fair (binary) or cagey fair (other AH)

draw_no_bet_excluded.today: separate draw no bet quotes excluded

order_within_group.today: value: P(positive return), EV, odds; cagey: no-loss, EV, odds

picks_per_match.today: one pick per match and market group

scope: Domestic leagues only (no European prices). Offers: home/away win and the main AH line at real prices; double chance 1X/X2/12 and draw no bet at derived prices (margin-free 1X2 plus that match's 1X2 overround); alternate AH lines (main -1.00 to +1.00) and Over 1.5 at synthetic prices (no historical price; accuracy only, never return). Bet365 period: Pinnacle-like prices from Bet365's margin-free probabilities plus Pinnacle's average margin. Quality = observed no-loss minus the cagey tier's predicted no-loss (Over 1.5: M's), per bet, whole weeks resampled. Locked: no holdout match is read.
